title: Quantum state localization in dipole-dipole interacting disordered networks
summary: We study the localization of excitations in positionally disordered spin or atom networks coupled via the realistic resonant dipole-dipole interaction (RDDI), which does not conform to a simple power law, as the spatial dependence and dissipative character distinguish it from conventional short or long-range models. Despite its partially long-ranged and radiative nature, positional disorder in the RDDI coupling leads to strong spatial localization of excitations.
